job.name: Secret_EventVignettes
job.prompt: Match the reference images exactly: hand-painted storybook rendering, warm ink line, soft painterly shading, the game's 'Waiting Realm' theme (a dream-like waiting room / after-hours toy shop: dark lacquered wood, brass and gilt filigree, aged paper and ink, deep velvet, warm lantern glow, gentle melancholy with whimsy). Every element completely isolated on a truly transparent background with large transparent margins, never touching or overlapping; no text, no letters, no numbers, no grid lines, no drop shadow outside the element, no ground. A production SHEET of 12 small oval VIGNETTE paintings, 4 columns x 3 rows, each a little storybook scene in a soft vignette that fades to transparent at its edges (no frame), used as the header picture of a secret room: 1 The Impossible Tailor (a tailor's table with glowing rainbow thread and a giant needle), 2 The Brass Crate (a locked brass shipping crate), 3 The Contraband Express (a tiny night train with crates on its roof), 4 The Empty Theatre (an empty stage with one spotlight), 5 The Hostile Duet (two music stands facing each other, sheet music flying), 6 The Leading Actor (a lone theatre mask on a velvet chair), 7 The Owner's Crate (a crate with a wax owner's seal and a ribbon), 8 The Paper Chorus (paper cut-out singers on strings), 9 The Sleeping Garden (a moonlit greenhouse with sleeping flowers), 10 The Thread Crate (a crate overflowing with spools), 11 The Understudy's Mirror (a tall dressing mirror reflecting a different shadow), 12 a spare generic one (a velvet curtain slightly open with light behind).

corrections: Precise production edit of the FIRST attached 12-scene sheet. Preserve all twelve scene identities, brushwork, palette, and exact row-major order. Keep EXACTLY FOUR equal columns and THREE equal rows on the same landscape canvas. Scale EACH entire scene uniformly down by TWENTY-FIVE PERCENT around the centre of its own equal grid cell. Every complete scene including its soft oval vignette fade must fit inside the central 75 percent of its cell, leaving large truly transparent gutters and outer margins on all four sides. No scene, haze, pigment or glow may cross a cell boundary or touch another scene. Preserve gentle soft alpha fade at each scene's own oval edge; remove all continuous coloured background haze between scenes. The background and gutters must be genuinely transparent RGBA alpha zero, never an opaque coloured background or painted checkerboard. Remove ALL writing, numbers, letters and text-like scribbles from every paper, music sheet, tag or crate; the flying music pages remain blank cream paper. No external frames or ground shadows. Nothing else changes.

LAYOUT CORRECTION ONLY. The attached sheet still has scenes crossing horizontal row boundaries. Repaint the SAME twelve illustrations as MUCH SMALLER separate oval vignettes on a genuine transparent sheet. Exactly 4 equal columns by 3 equal rows, same row-major order. Each scene INCLUDING every fade, ornament and glow occupies ONLY THE CENTRAL 55 PERCENT of its equal cell in BOTH width and height. Roughly HALF the current width and height per scene. Leave enormous completely empty transparent gutters, approximately one scene-height between rows and half a scene-width between columns. Scene centres normalized to canvas: x=12.5%,37.5%,62.5%,87.5%; y=16.67%,50%,83.33%. Do NOT enlarge artwork to fill the page. All backgrounds between and around scenes are fully alpha zero; no continuous coloured fog. Preserve every requested scene's complete contents, hand-painted ink and velvet/brass/amber/teal style. No text or numbers, no decorative frames. This is a sprite atlas, not a full-page collage. Soft oval alpha fades end well inside each individual cell. Keep landscape 1536x1024.

validation.notes: Native output preserved. No resizing, alpha cleanup or background removal by code. Faint generated alpha fringe may remain.
